Creator visual regression baselines are grouped by renderer and platform.

The rollout CI script executes the regression suite and fails when perceptual
drift exceeds renderer thresholds. Baseline image artifacts can be stored under:

- `linkedin/`
- `x/`
- `instagram/`
- `facebook/`
- `infographic_layouts/`
- `carousel_layouts/`
- `brand_cards/`
- `banners/`
